name: redact-restore
description: Reversible redaction for Claude Code: private values are replaced with placeholders before the model API sees them and restored locally. No API gateway.

enabled.title: Enable privacy filtering
enabled.description: Redact supported text before it enters Claude model context.

custom_values.title: Exact private values
custom_values.description: One value per entry, matched exactly as typed and masked as {{PRIVATE:CUSTOM#<id>}}. Stored in the system keychain. To give a value its own label or a fixed alias, use /redact-restore rules. Entered only on your own machine.

custom_patterns.title: Private patterns
custom_patterns.description: Regular expressions for private values, one per entry, stored like Exact private values. Each entry is one JavaScript regex source without slashes or flags, used whole (nothing in it is parsed), matched as a whole word and masked as {{PRIVATE:CUSTOM#<id>}}; Ignore capitalization applies. Entries that are invalid or could match slowly are skipped. For a label, part-only masking or a test example, use /redact-restore rules.

custom_case_insensitive.title: Ignore capitalization in custom matches
custom_case_insensitive.description: Match configured private values regardless of case.

redact_emails.title: Automatically mask email addresses
redact_emails.description: Detect email addresses with a simple built-in pattern.

enable_detectors.title: Extra detectors
enable_detectors.description: Comma-separated detector ids or groups to turn on besides the defaults, e.g. gitleaks.generic-api-key, or groups gitleaks, all. Most detectors, including ipv4, phone and us_ssn, are on by default.

disable_detectors.title: Disabled detectors
disable_detectors.description: Comma-separated detector ids or groups to turn off, e.g. ipv4, phone, us_ssn, cn_phone, secret_assignment, groups network, pii, cn, gitleaks (all 212 rules), or gitleaks.<rule-id>. Wins over Extra detectors.

placeholder_format.title: Placeholder format
placeholder_format.description: How placeholders look. Default {{PRIVATE:{label}#{id}}}, e.g. {{PRIVATE:EMAIL#3fa1c09e8b2d}}. Must contain {id} once, may contain {label}, start with literal text, have no whitespace, and separate {label} and {id}. Alternatives: {{{label}_{id}}}, PRIVATE_{label}_{id} (identifier style, safe unquoted in YAML and templates), <<{label}:{id}>>.

placeholder_id_length.title: Placeholder id length
placeholder_id_length.description: Random hex characters per placeholder, 8 to 32. Default 12 keeps placeholders short and unique within a session.

placeholder_ids.title: Placeholder ids across sessions
placeholder_ids.description: random: a value gets a new placeholder in each session. stable: the same value gets the same placeholder in every session (derived from a key kept in the plugin store on this machine), so the provider can tell that two sessions mention the same value, though not what it is.

restore_display.title: Restore local message display
restore_display.description: Show original values in locally rendered chat messages, tool rows and questions.

restore_display_rows.title: Rows restored on screen
restore_display_rows.description: Comma-separated rows that show original values when restore_display is on: UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ToolUse, ToolResult, AskUserQuestion.

restore_streaming.title: Restore while replies stream
restore_streaming.description: Show original values while a reply is still streaming, not only once it is complete. The engine records the rewritten text, which is masked again before it is stored. Off keeps placeholders visible until the reply finishes.

restore_mode.title: Restore original values in tool calls
restore_mode.description: all: every local tool gets original values (shell, file edits, local MCP) except keep_tools. files: only Write/Edit/NotebookEdit. none: tools always get placeholder text.

keep_tools.title: Extra tools that keep placeholders
keep_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names added to the built-in list of model-bound and remote tools (Agent, Task, Workflow, WebFetch, WebSearch, SendMessage, Skill, RemoteTrigger, CronCreate, ScheduleWakeup, SendFeedback, PushNotification, Artifact, ArtifactData, ArtifactComments), which always keep placeholders. * matches any text, e.g. mcp__remote__*.

deny_unrestored_tools.title: Extra tools refused on placeholders
deny_unrestored_tools.description: Comma-separated tool names added to the built-in list (Write, Edit, NotebookEdit). Refused when they would receive placeholder text without restoration.

allow_media.title: Allow unscannable media
allow_media.description: Send images, PDFs and other attachments that Redact Restore cannot scan. Off: they are withheld or the prompt is refused.

outbound_audit.title: Audit outgoing requests
outbound_audit.description: Before each model request, scan the conversation's user-side content and refuse to send when a private value is still unmasked.

status_line.title: Status line
status_line.description: Line under the prompt: off, count ("4 private values masked"), or detailed (counts by kind, tool restore mode, audit). Shows counts only, never values.

status_format.title: Status line template
status_format.description: Optional template replacing the preset, e.g. "{state} 🔒{masked} +{lastTurn} ⛔{blocked}". Fields: {masked} {emails} {detected} {custom} {occurrences} {lastTurn} {restored} {kept} {denied} {audits} {blocked} {media} {state} {mode} {audit} {streaming} {version}.

status_file.title: Write status for a status-line script
status_file.description: Write counters and state (never values) to ~/.claude/redact-restore/status/<session_id>.json so a custom statusLine command can show them.

scan_skip_dirs.title: Folders a path scan skips
scan_skip_dirs.description: Comma-separated folder names /redact-restore scan PATH skips, added to the built-in list (.git, node_modules, .venv, venv, __pycache__, dist, build, target, vendor, .next, coverage, .cache).

scan_max_files.title: Files a path scan reads at most
scan_max_files.description: How many files /redact-restore scan PATH looks at, read or skipped, before it stops (default 2000, at most 20000). Files over 256 KiB and binary files are skipped.

rule_labels.title: Labels in the rule form
rule_labels.description: Comma-separated labels offered in the rules pane's Label list, e.g. CUSTOMER, VENDOR, TEAM. Empty: the built-in list (CUSTOM, NAME, CUSTOMER, ORG, PROJECT, HOST, EMAIL, USER, SECRET, ADDRESS, PHONE). Labels your rules already use are always added, and Other label… takes any label.
